title: Six-Step Data Science Workflow
description: An interactive infographic showing the six-step linear data science workflow process
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: data science
workflow
process
methodology
infographic
learningObjectives: Identify the six steps of the data science workflow: define the problem, collect data, clean data, analyze data, visualize results, and communicate insights
Sequence the six workflow steps in correct order and explain why problem definition must precede data collection
Explain the purpose of each workflow step, such as why raw data must be cleaned before statistical analysis
Classify activities from a real-world data project (for example gathering survey responses or building a chart) into the correct workflow step
